english.title: Fail to comply with measure under reg 40 re electronic cigarette / refill containers which may present health risk
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[producer]_
(B)_[supplier]_
(C)_[producer and supplier]_

of

(D)_[electronic cigarettes]_
(E)_[refill containers]_
(F)_[electronic cigarettes and refill containers]_

that were the subject of a provisional measure or a follow-up measure under regulation 40 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016, namely **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF MEASURE..), failed to comply with that measure insofar as it applied to you
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 40, 48(d) and 51 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
producer / supplier
of electronic cigarettes / refill containers subject of r40 measure
failed to comply with that measure

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) In any proceedings for an offence under these Regulations brought against a person who supplies any tobacco product or related product in breach of these Regulations, it is a defence that the supplier exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
